verdict.rationale: Style-guide linting before publish is a fair axis for a documentation site generator, but nothing in the evidence shows Docusaurus shipping content linting, style-guide checks, or pre-publish issue flagging. The pluggable architecture and the build command are generic building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a technical writer, automated checks lint my content against a style guide and flag issues before they publish
